meta.notes: Criterion microbenchmark baseline for hot-path operations. Values are nanoseconds per operation measured on standard GitHub Actions CI runner.

id_generation.description: Time to generate a single unique ID (20-char ULID-like)

email_validation_basic.description: Time to validate a well-formed email address

email_validation_invalid.description: Time to reject an invalid email address

hmac_signing.description: Time to create an HMAC-SHA256 signature

template_render_simple.description: Time to render a simple Handlebars template with 3 variables

template_render_complex.description: Time to render a complex template with loops, conditionals, and partials

json_serialize_email.description: Time to serialize a standard email payload to JSON

json_deserialize_email.description: Time to deserialize a standard email payload from JSON
